title: FrameRef: A Framing Dataset and Simulation Testbed for Modeling Bounded Rational Information Health

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the acceptance rate and confidence of refuted claims across five distinct framing dimensions (authoritative, consensus, emotional, prestige, sensationalist) using Monte Carlo trajectory sampling on fine-tuned LLM personas, as well as conducting human evaluations to assess the impact of framing on human judgment accuracy.
